customer_by_email.reads: all customers (43 MB): no index on lower(email)

order_history.reads: all orders (403 MB): no index on customer_id

orders_delivered.reads: the first delivered orders (98% are delivered, so the scan stops early)

orders_by_status.reads: most of orders for a rare status

order_detail.reads: order and lines by key, all payments (372 MB): no index on order_id

product_search.reads: all products (25 MB, stays in memory)

product_detail.reads: product by key, all reviews (142 MB): no index on product_id

top_products.reads: orders and order lines of a period (1.4 GB)

place_order.reads: prices and stock by key, three inserts

change_status.reads: order by key, update of payments by order_id (372 MB)

background.about: All day on the app server: a little real use, only requests that need no full scan

read-heavy.about: 90% reads, 10% writes: a shop that is mostly browsed

write-heavy.about: 30% reads, 70% writes: a sale, with many orders and clicks

spike.about: The mixed load, with a short burst of PEAK times the rate in the middle

soak.about: The mixed load for a long time: slow growth, leaks, vacuum
